elevenlabsPrompt:
[intrigued] Missed another call on silent? Your iPhone can flash instead.

[confident] Here's the fix. Turn on LED Flash for Alerts.

[friendly] Open Settings, then Accessibility. Tap Audio and Visual. Switch on LED Flash for Alerts. Turn on Flash in Silent Mode too.

[delighted] Now the light blinks for every call, even on silent.

[warm] One tech tip a day, at techtipaday dot com.
